tasks.label: Inspect Git worktree
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\user\Student Internship and Industrial Attachment Management System'; $candidates = @('C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe','C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe',($env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Programs\Git\cmd\git.exe')); $git = Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($git) { $exe = $git.Source } else { $exe = $candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1 }; if (-not $exe) { Write-Output 'GIT_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1 }; & $exe status --short --branch; & $exe branch --show-current; & $exe diff --stat; & $exe diff --cached --stat; & $exe remote -v

tasks.label: Search common Git install locations
tasks.command: $roots = @('C:\Program Files\Git','C:\Program Files (x86)\Git',($env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Programs\Git'),($env:USERPROFILE + '\scoop\apps\git'),($env:ChocolateyInstall + '\bin')); foreach ($root in $roots) { if ($root -and (Test-Path $root)) { Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Filter git.exe -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 -ExpandProperty FullName } }

tasks.label: Install Git for requested push
tasks.command: $winget = Get-Command winget.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $winget) { Write-Output 'WINGET_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1 }; winget install --id Git.Git --exact --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

tasks.label: Find verification env key
args: const fs = require("fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync("backend/.env", "utf8"); const names = text.split(/\r?\n/).map(line => line.split("=")[0].trim()).filter(name => name.toLowerCase().includes("verify")); console.log(JSON.stringify(names));
